verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence is Marqeta's MCP Server. It lets the customer's own AI agents query and analyze Core API data in natural language. That is a building block for external agents, not AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered inside the Marqeta product. No evidence shows any in-product AI insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
